thread:
maria (PM): Quick sync — Customer X is asking to onboard their main model family into our catalog with two asks: pinned-version guarantees and a 90d deprecation notice. We need to decide slot allocation, bench gates, and customer migration incentives. Anyone free to weigh in?

jia (Eng): I can take slot sizing. Question: do they want dedicted capacity (Dedicated) or just pin on hosted? That changes the economics.

katie (Sales): They're on hosted today but want a contractual pin for the next quarter while they finish rollout. They'll pay for a small committed monthly spend if we guarantee pin TTL.

samir (ML): From eval side, we need a benchmark set from them. We should require their canonical prompt suite + our standard regressions. Gate: no >5% regression on pass@k and perplexity on devset.

maria (PM): Proposed acceptance criteria (draft): 1) perf regressions <=5% on defined prompt suite 2) latency P95 within 1.2x of current model on same hw 3) model quantization tested on our cheap pool with <3% quality delta. OK?

jia (Eng): That seems reasonable. For pin mechanics we need a backing policy: pinned variant will be a pinned model alias that maps to a version. If we fail SLA we should auto-fallback to next-compatible variant. Suggest adding canary window for 48h before pin becomes active.

ethan (SRE): Canaries are fine. Ops needs explicit traffic routing rules and a rollback hook. Also: if pinned model increases infra cost by >15% we need billing alert and approval.

katie (Sales): Customer asks for a 90d deprecation notice for any pin removal. They accept migration assistance (credits + one on-call cutover). Can we formalize a migration SLA?

samir (ML): Migration SLA we typically do: 30-day migration runway with 2 weeks of canary on customer traffic and 1 week hot-fix window. Offer one migration credit (30% credits) as incentive.

maria (PM): Let's capture scope decisions: pinned TTL options: 30d (default), 90d (premium, extra commit), custom 180d (enterprise). Pricing delta table to be drafted. Also need model onboarding playbook: required artifacts, bench results, & opt-in telemetry.

jia (Eng): Implementation notes: minimal config example for a pin submission — include in playbook:

```yaml
pin_request:
  model: orca-lite-v2
  version: v2026-03-01
  requested_ttl_days: 90
  canary_duration_hours: 48
  bench_suite: customerX-v1
  quant_profile: int8-fast
```

jia (Eng): We'll add automation to refuse pins that didn't pass quant profile tests on our cheap pool.

ethan (SRE): ops-bot will create a canary run and route 0.5% traffic for 48h, then escalate to 10% if no errors. Adding a check: memory growth <5% over baseline.

ops-bot: canary job queued -> job_id: cj-55321, scheduled for 2026-04-05T14:00Z.

maria (PM): Next steps: Jia to size slots and estimate infra delta, Samir to define bench pass/fail thresholds and migration credit proposal, Katie to confirm commercial terms with Customer X, and I'll draft the onboarding SOW and pin-tier pricing. Target doc by EOW. Sound good? :thumbsup:

katie (Sales): Sounds good. I'll get commercial ok and share customer prompt suite by EOD.

samir (ML): Will prepare bench harness and an initial regression matrix.

jia (Eng): I'll post slot estimates + rough cost delta by tomorrow.

maria (PM): Thanks all — logging follow-ups in the playbook ticket.
